name: VPS Configuration
author: Brett
description: The gate a PR must pass before it lands, and the auto-lander that lands it, in one place (gate-rules@1, framework/spec/GATE.md). Rules tab: every gate rule (CI green, tests, theme, controls, toolbars, UI Review, code clash, merge-queue policy) with its on/off switch, severity and settings, Reset to defaults and Check a PR. Auto-lander tab: one mode switch Merge queue on/off (on = PRs go through the stacked merge queue; off, the default = the auto-lander lands each finished build one at a time), status, waiting PRs with the rule that holds each one and why, last runs, Land now, Pause and Resume. History tab: every rule change and lander action (who, when, before/after). The same calls through REST (/api/plugins/gate), MCP (gate_* and lander_*), the CLI (axf gate …) and voice. Rules and history live in the plugin's data folder; the lander settings are mirrored into the merge-queue provider's config so one switch is the switch the lander obeys. Two adapters (gate-store.mjs, lander.mjs) are the only files a later axf-molly backend replaces.

items.title: Gate rules: list
items.description: The gate rule set (gate-rule-set@1): every rule a PR must pass before it lands, with on/off, severity, who runs it and its settings. Filter by kind, enabled or owner.

items.title: Gate rules: one rule
items.description: One gate rule and the default it would get back on Reset.

items.title: Gate rules: change a rule
items.description: Change one gate rule: enabled, severity (block, warn, info), owner, settings (merged), title or description. Logged in History with before and after.

items.title: Gate rules: switch a rule on or off
items.description: Switch one gate rule on or off ({enabled}). Logged in History.

items.title: Gate rules: reset to defaults (confirm)
items.description: Reset one rule ({id}) or every rule to the defaults. Two-step: the first call answers confirmation_required with a token; call again with confirm set to it.

items.title: Gate: can this PR land?
items.description: Can this PR land? The gate verdict (gate-verdict@1) for one PR (pr or branch) from what the lander knows, rule by rule. Changes nothing.

items.title: Gate: history
items.description: Rule changes and lander actions, newest first: who, when, before and after, why. Filter by kind (rule, lander), since, pr, rule, action.

items.title: Auto-lander: status
items.description: The auto-lander: status (running, paused, idle, off, error), the Merge queue switch and mode, the PR landing now, how many wait, the last run.

items.title: Auto-lander: waiting PRs
items.description: PRs waiting to land, in order, each with the gate rule that holds it and why in plain words.

items.title: Auto-lander: last runs
items.description: The lander's last runs, newest first (auto-lander-run@1): result, PR, mode, reason.

items.title: Auto-lander: Merge queue switch
items.description: The Merge queue switch: on = the stacked merge queue, off (default) = the auto-lander lands one build at a time.

items.title: Auto-lander: flip the Merge queue switch
items.description: Flip the Merge queue switch ({mergeQueue: true|false}). Takes effect at once (the lander reads it every round) and is logged in History.

items.title: Auto-lander: land a PR next (confirm)
items.description: Put a PR at the head of the line in the current mode ({pr}). Two-step confirm; it still passes every rule and is never a direct merge.

items.title: Auto-lander: pause
items.description: Pause the auto-lander ({why}): what is landing finishes, nothing new starts. Logged in History; raises the lander-paused alert.

items.title: Auto-lander: resume
items.description: Resume the auto-lander in its current mode. Logged in History.

items.title: Server auto-lander: status
items.description: The lander (lander@1, deploy/lander/run.mjs on the VPS): service up, the build landing, every build waiting to land with its live status from the builds store (merging-pr, pr-pulling-main, running-ci, merging-main, failed with attempt N), the builds failing repeatedly, settings.

items.title: Server auto-lander: one build's attempts
items.description: One build in the lander: its status, status log (every change with at and by), attempt and failure, and its PRs.

items.title: Server auto-lander: run a tick now
items.description: Ask the server auto-lander for a tick now (it runs within a minute): merge main into clashing builds, start fix sessions for red CI, hand green PRs to the merge queue.

items.title: Server auto-lander: retry a build
items.description: Reset one build's attempts and escalation; the next tick tries again from attempt 1. Resolves its phone alert.

items.title: Server auto-lander: fix a build now
items.description: Reset one build and start a fix session for it on the next tick, whatever CI says (the escalation item's Fix).

items.title: Server auto-lander: pause
items.description: Pause the server auto-lander: nothing new is merged, fixed or landed until it is resumed.

items.title: Server auto-lander: resume
items.description: Resume the server auto-lander.

items.title: Server auto-lander: settings
items.description: The server auto-lander's settings: enabled, maxAttempts (1-10), backoffBaseMin, backoffFactor, backoffMaxMin, attemptTimeoutMin, pushOnEscalation.

sizeCapLines.description: lines one PR may carry before a build's steps are split into 2, 3 or more PRs

items.title: Server auto-lander: change settings
items.description: Change the lander's settings (deploy/lander/run.mjs): enabled, sizeCapLines (the one-PR size cap), flakyReruns, backoffBaseMin/Factor/MaxMin, ciNoneKickMin, ciTimeoutMin, fixTimeoutMin, notifyAfterAttempts, workflow, mergeMethod; {key: value, …} or {key, value}.

items.title: Model triage: rules and decisions
items.description: The VPS model triage gate (model-triage@1): the rules that decide which model each build step, emergency build, hand build and lander fix session runs on, in order, with their settings; the default model; whether Fable upgrades wait for Brett; the last decisions (model, rule, why).

items.title: Model triage: change a rule

op.description: rule = edit one rule; move = its place; defaults = the gate's own settings; enabled = the whole gate; reset = the starting rules

id.description: the rule (ci-fix, merge-clash, second-try, contracts, blast-radius, size, cross-cutting, designer, fable-words, simple-work)

enabled.description: the rule (op rule) or the whole gate (op enabled) on or off

model.description: the model the rule sends work to (op rule), or the model for work no rule matched (op defaults)

settings.description: the rule's numbers and lists, e.g. {"files": 8} for size or {"dependents": 10} for blast-radius

to.description: the rule's new place, 0 = first (op move)

handRequest.description: what a hand launch's own model means (op defaults)

briefWords.description: a brief or step that names its model wins (op defaults)

items.description: Change the model triage gate: one rule's on/off, model, lanes or settings, its place in the order, the default model, or reset to the starting rules. Checked on the VPS; every change is in the history.

items.title: Model triage: decisions
items.description: The gate's decision log, newest first: build and step (or session), lane, model, the rule that fired and why. Filter by build, lane; limit.

items.title: Model triage: rule changes
items.description: Every change to the model triage rules, newest first: who, when, what, why.

items.title: Model triage: what would the gate answer

kind.description: ci-red, clash-main or rules for a lander fix

requested.description: the model a hand launch asked for

items.description: Ask the gate which model a piece of work would get and which rule decides. Changes and logs nothing.

items.title: Build cap: status
items.description: The build cap (build-cap@1): the host hard cap (maxBuilds), emergency slots and the orchestrator's stepsInParallel side by side, what runs now, how many really run at once and the note when the numbers disagree.

items.title: Build cap: change

stepsInParallel.description: steps of one build sent at once

maxBuilds.description: the host hard cap; Brett's signed-in console only

emergencySlots.description: the emergency pool; Brett's signed-in console only

items.description: Change the build cap: stepsInParallel (1-12) from anywhere; maxBuilds (1-64) and emergencySlots (0-8) only from Brett's own signed-in console (a session, MCP or voice is refused with 403).

items.title: Approval rules: status
items.description: Approval rules (approval-rules@1): each axHub service's ordered match-pattern rules (match, decision allow / veto / confirm / deny, hold seconds), how many tools each rule decides now, the staged draft, and whether Brett's default (a veto countdown only on VPS shell commands) is applied.

items.title: Approval rules: stage an edit

op.description: what to do; default stages Brett's default, discard drops the draft (or one service's)

index.description: which rule, 0-based (edit, remove, move; add: where to insert)

match.description: a tool name or a pattern; * stands for any run of characters (build_*, *_run, *)

rules.description: set: the service's whole ordered list

clearOwn.description: set: also clear the tools' own entries on save, so the rules decide

items.description: Stage one edit to the approval rules. It lands in a draft and changes nothing on axHub: only Brett saves the draft, with his own click in his signed-in console (Builds → VPS Configuration → Approval rules). The first matching rule wins; a tool's own entry beats every rule.

items.title: Gate: plugin settings
items.description: The plugin's settings: refreshSec, historySize, defaultTab.

items.title: Gate: change plugin settings
items.description: Change the plugin's settings: refreshSec (5-600), historySize (50-20000), defaultTab (rules, build-rules, auto-lander, build-cap, model-triage, approvals, passes, history).

items.title: Build rules: list
items.description: Every build rule (build-rule@1): who does it (vps or session), kind, phase, on/off, check, fixer and its last run. Filters doer, kind, phase, enabled, q.

items.title: Build rules: one rule
items.description: One build rule with its last runs and its change history.

items.title: Build rules: add a rule
items.description: Add a build rule ({rule: {id, title, text, doer, kind, phase, check?, autofix?, briefBlock?, applies?, when?}} or the fields). A vps rule is done by the VPS and never reaches a session brief.

items.title: Build rules: change a rule
items.description: Change a build rule ({patch} or the fields: title, text, doer, kind, phase, check, autofix, briefBlock, applies, when, note). Logged in the rule history with before and after.

items.title: Build rules: switch a rule on or off
items.description: Switch a build rule on or off ({enabled}; none = flip). Logged in the rule history.

items.title: Build rules: delete a rule (confirm)
items.description: Delete a build rule. Two-step: the first call answers confirmation_required with a token; call again with confirm set to it. History keeps the rule.

items.title: Build rules: change history
items.description: Every change to the build rules, newest first (build-rule-history@1). Filters id, action, since, limit.

items.title: Build rules: runs
items.description: Every check and fix the VPS ran (build-rule-run@1: pass, fixed, fail, skipped), newest first. Filters id, build, result, since, limit.

items.title: Build rules: run a phase now
items.description: Run the build rules of one phase (before, after, gate) for a build ({build, phase, rules?, dryRun?}): checks, fixes what fails, re-checks, and logs to History. dryRun changes nothing.

items.title: Build rules: a session's brief
items.description: What a build session's brief gets from the store (brief-blocks@1) for {build, title, text, ui}: only session rules; VPS rules never reach it.
